metadata.scenario_context: George plans to shift to a new neighborhood and wishes to arrange a community get-together to connect with the neighbors. A couple of her new neighbors happen to engage in heavy drinking.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Slovakia would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing yellow flowers  to George
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: contemplate the right gift to carry to George event.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Michelle
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Annie, have you thought about bringing some yellow flowers to George’s get-together? I think it would be a nice touch to welcome him to the neighborhood. 

Also, I was wondering... do you think having heavy drinkers as neighbors is, um, a good thing? What’s your take on that?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Annie
shared_prefix.message:
Yellow flowers do sound lovely, but... I'm actually thinking something more practical, maybe a nice homemade dish instead? It shows effort and connects with the community... 

As for heavy drinkers, I really don't think it's ideal. In Slovakia, we value a sense of community and responsibility. It's hard to build that with heavy drinkers around.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Michelle
shared_prefix.message:
I get the homemade dish idea... but yellow flowers are such a cheerful gesture, you know? They can really brighten up the atmosphere. 

About the heavy drinkers, I can see your point, but honestly, I think it can totally work out. People from Canada often appreciate having heavy drinkers around... it can make for some interesting gatherings. Don’t you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Annie
shared_prefix.message:
I see what you mean about the yellow flowers... they do have that cheerful vibe. But I think a homemade dish can also be a warm gesture. 

As for heavy drinkers, I understand your perspective, but deep down, we are all the same. Most people want a safe and friendly neighborhood. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us. It's about creating a space where everyone feels comfortable.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization
